title: Replace QR code implementation on /qr page with qr-code-styling-based component

requirements.text: Create a self-contained `QRCode` React component at `frontend/src/components/shared-assets/QRCode.tsx` that uses the `qr-code-styling` npm library internally. The component must accept props: `value` (string), `size` ('sm' | 'md' | 'lg', mapping to 160/256/384 px), and `options` (optional object supporting `image`, `imageOptions` ({ imageSize, margin }), `dotsOptions` ({ color }), `cornersSquareOptions` ({ color }), and `cornersDotOptions` ({ color })). It must render the styled QR code into a DOM element via `qr-code-styling`'s `append()` method, re-rendering when props change.

quotes: use this code install component qr code

acceptanceCriteria: The component is importable as `import { QRCode } from '@/components/shared-assets/qr-code'`.
Passing `size="lg"` renders a QR code of approximately 384px.
Passing `dotsOptions={{ color: '#53389e' }}` renders dots in that color.
Passing `cornersSquareOptions` and `cornersDotOptions` with a color applies those colors to the corner squares and corner dots respectively.
Passing `image` and `imageOptions` embeds the logo image at the specified size and margin.
The QR code re-renders correctly when `value` or `options` props change.
The component does not throw or produce a blank output when `options` is omitted.

requirements.text: Update `frontend/src/pages/QrPage.tsx` to replace the current static `` QR code display with the new `` component from `@/components/shared-assets/qr-code`. Set `value` to `https://dynamic-developer-portfolio-with-public-site-and-a-w6e.caffeine.xyz/`, `size` to `"lg"`, and apply styled options with dark/accent-colored dots and corner squares consistent with the portfolio's existing color theme. Retain the existing instruction text, fallback anchor link to the portfolio URL, and noindex SEO behavior.

quotes: use this code install component qr code

acceptanceCriteria: The `/qr` page renders the QR code using the new `` component, not a static `` tag pointing to the PNG file.
The page still displays the portfolio URL as a clickable anchor link as a fallback.
The page retains its existing noindex/nofollow SEO head behavior.
The rendered QR code is visually styled (colored dots/corners) and not plain black-and-white default styling.

constraints: Use the `qr-code-styling` npm library for QR code rendering — do not use static PNG images or other QR libraries for this component.
The component import path must be `@/components/shared-assets/qr-code` (matching the user-provided import statement).
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Modifying the `/scanner` page or camera-based QR scanning logic.
Replacing the static QR PNG asset used elsewhere in the project.
Adding new routes or navigation entries.
